newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linde - no comment on Messer takeover talk.
newsitem.headline: Linde - no comment on Messer takeover talk.

text.p: German plant and engineering group Linde AG on Monday declined to comment on a report it was considering buying chemical group Hoechst AG's Messer Griesheim unit, calling the report "pure speculation".
German newsletter Platow Brief reported late last week that Linde was interested in obtaining Messer Griesheim, which produces industrial gases.
"The report consists of pure speculation," a Linde spokesman said in answer to a Reuter enquiry.
Hoechst also declined to comment on the report.
Hoechst has been spinning off units in recent months but chemical industry analysts said Hoechst appeared more interested in placing Messer shares on the bourse than selling the unit outright.
A date for a possible bourse listing however has not been set yet.
